speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: You are late for the horses and early enough for me. Six of them, and they have been steaming since before noon. Carrier in at the Bell, as the day said.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in a play, Master Hobbins. The horses knew how to eat without me. What does the road cost this week?

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Oats dear at Oxford. Malt dearer at home. The harvest is in, and you could carry it in your hat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is a thin hat. You have a letter for me, I think, before I give you one.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: One side, from your wife. The money came. She says so, and she does not say it twice, which is her way when a thing is true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Michaelmas money. It went with you on the second. I am glad it is in the house, and it is not a new sum.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Susanna reads the Gospel to her grandmother of an evening, and corrects the curate under her breath. Judith has a new song off a pedlar and will not say what she gave for it. Hamnet and the Sadler boy dammed the brook at Shottery and were made to undam it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not answer the song, and I will not answer the brook. She has made both of them better than a postscript of mine.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then the foot of it. Master Quiney is for London at Martinmas on the town's business and means to find you. He is a good man. Keep your purse in your other hose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is a good man, and he is not in London tonight. He owes two pound. I am not repaying it across a yard of horses. The purse can change hose without opening.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence the letter, if you have one to go back. Sixpence if you have made it a parcel. That corner in your hand looks like twopence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. Three lines from Sunday, and one more, if you will let me write it on the corner of this table where the ink can dry before your bag.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The corner is yours. I will put the letter into my list when the line is there to read. In the spring I did not read them back. I have been blamed for a word since, and I will not be blamed for this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it back when I have finished. Not before. I will not have a line in your list that my hand has not yet made.
